homemade.costume: a simple homemade Halloween costume of your own invention, pieced together from everyday household materials
homemade.props: one small homemade prop of your own choosing that suits the costume

vampire.costume: a vampire costume: a black cape with a tall stiff red-lined collar
props: a miniature gold medallion on a ribbon
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace

a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace

a small felt sunflower pinned at the neck

props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace
a small silver flying-saucer badge pinned at the neck

astronaut.costume: a homemade astronaut costume: a puffy white quilted bodysuit with visible stitching and gray duct-tape trim, and a clear round plastic bubble helmet over its head, its face fully visible through it

a small foil-covered cardboard oxygen pack strapped to its back

a tiny string of pearls around its neck
